clue.text: Set foot in it and ask a lot of questions

definitions.meaning: a light dancing shoe, something you put your foot into
to quiz someone persistently for information

explanation.surface: Someone blunders socially and then interrogates everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set foot in it' sounds like the idiom for blundering, but read literally it is a shoe you step into.
explanation.definitionFit: A pump is a light slip-on shoe, and to pump someone is to question them hard for information.

clue.text: Ring round about cash not above asset-stripping

indicators.note: the ringing sound is placed so it encircles the other pieces

parts.note: a ring of a bell is a ping
L, for pounds sterling, stands for money
below, which is under

explanation.surface: A gangster surrounds someone, demanding money, while stripping their assets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' as a noun suggests jewellery or a gang, but here it is the sound of a bell; 'round about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Plundering is robbing and despoiling, much as asset-stripping loots a company of its valuables.

clue.text: Drink one may have when the weather's inclement

definitions.meaning: a Burgundy wine from the French town of that name

definitions.text: one may have when the weather's inclement
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a raincoat worn

explanation.surface: A suggestion of what to sip on a rainy day.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as MAC ON: a mac (raincoat) is what you have on in bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Mâcon is a French white or red Burgundy wine; split in two it describes wearing a raincoat.

clue.text: Sailors having a smile about the French ways

indicators.note: the smile goes around the French article, enclosing it

parts.note: to beam is to smile broadly
les is the French plural 'the'
E and N are compass directions, ways one might go

explanation.surface: Grinning mariners wandering the streets of France.
explanation.walkthrough: Compass points count as 'ways' in crosswords, since each is a direction; 'about' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Able seamen are the trained ratings of the navy, so they are seafarers.

clue.text: Robber gang carrying gear

indicators.note: the gang holds the gear within it

parts.note: a band is a group of people
rig is equipment or kit

explanation.surface: A thief's gang is laden with equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigand is a bandit who robs travellers, so a type of thief.

clue.text: Note cuts and note concealment

parts.note: E is a musical note
clips are trims or snips
E again, another musical note

explanation.surface: A musician trims a note and hides another.
explanation.definitionFit: An eclipse is the hiding of one heavenly body by another, so an obscuring.

clue.text: A consumer of some taste — a terse individual

indicators.note: only part of these words is needed, some of their letters running across them

explanation.surface: A diner of refined taste who is curt in speech.
explanation.definitionFit: One who eats is literally a consumer of food.

clue.text: Pretending, and so managing to get on

definitions.meaning: claiming falsely, as in 'he's not as ill as he's ___'

explanation.surface: Someone bluffing their way through and somehow succeeding.
explanation.definitionFit: To make out is both to claim falsely and to fare or get along.

clue.text: Women of habit

parts.note: seemingly creatures of routine, but a habit is also religious dress, so these are women in religious orders

explanation.surface: Ladies who always stick to their routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Nuns are women of religious orders who wear the robe called a habit.

clue.text: Unrestricted choice of decoration receiving little back-up

indicators.note: the decoration takes the other piece into itself

parts.note: a frill is an ornamental edging

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: wee is Scots for small

explanation.surface: Picking an ornament freely, with a bit of support.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'back-up' reads a word upwards; 'receiving' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Free will is the power to choose without constraint.

clue.text: Rain-cloud formation might well make one fractious!

indicators.note: the letters are formed into a new arrangement, as a cloud takes shape

explanation.surface: A gathering storm cloud could make anyone irritable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being uncordial means being unfriendly and ill-tempered, much like being irritable.

clue.text: Sign agreement in secure retreat

indicators.note: the agreement goes inside the other piece
to retreat is to go back, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: to net is to catch or secure
OK expresses assent

explanation.surface: A signed accord is kept in a safe hideaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' looks like a noun for a hideaway but signals reading a word backwards; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A token is a symbol or indication of something.

clue.text: Crowded together, which is stupid

explanation.surface: An observation that packed crowds are foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Dense means both tightly packed and slow to understand.

clue.text: Hopeful partisan going to the dogs

indicators.note: deteriorating into disorder, so the letters fall apart and regroup

explanation.surface: A party supporter's hopes are collapsing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hopeful, as a noun, is a candidate who aspires to something.

clue.text: Got up and phoned in 1 — changed the order

indicators.note: the phone call is placed inside the other word

parts.note: reared, as a horse rearing up on its hind legs
rang, as in made a phone call

explanation.surface: Someone rose, made a call and rearranged things.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray '1' in the printed clue does no work; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To rearrange something is to put it in a different sequence.

clue.text: Made some response when a salesman told stories

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
told fibs, lied

explanation.surface: A salesman answered by spinning tales.
explanation.definitionFit: To reply is to give an answer.

clue.text: Care taken once rip is made

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new, reworked

explanation.surface: Care is needed once a tear has been created.
explanation.definitionFit: Precision is exactness, taking pains to be accurate.

clue.text: The viewer's rightful place

parts.note: seemingly a spectator's seat, but the viewer is the eye and its place is a hole to look through

explanation.surface: A spectator demanding their proper seat.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyehole is an opening to peep through, or the socket housing the eye.

clue.text: Inspector at one time a pit-worker

parts.note: ex means former
a miner works in a pit

explanation.surface: An inspector who used to be a coal miner.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner inspects or tests things.

clue.text: They're very sharp — use their eyes!

definitions.text: They're very sharp — use their eyes!

parts.words: They're very sharp — use their eyes!
parts.note: seemingly keen-eyed people, but these are sewing tools pointed at one end, with an eye for thread

explanation.surface: Advice to watch those who are quick-witted.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewing needles are pointed and have an eye through which thread passes.

clue.text: Walk lumberingly along quiet promenade

parts.note: sh is a call for silence
to amble is to stroll

explanation.surface: Lumbering along a quiet seaside walk.
explanation.definitionFit: To shamble is to move awkwardly, dragging the feet.

clue.text: Providing the small child with more suitable reading-matter

parts.note: ch is an abbreviation for child
apter, more apt

explanation.surface: Giving a little one a more fitting book.
explanation.definitionFit: A chapter is a section of a book, something to be read.

clue.text: Transport record prepared by a writer of fiction !

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a roll is a list or register

explanation.surface: A novelist arranges vehicle records.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Carroll wrote the Alice books, so is a novelist.

clue.text: Greek character in subordinate situation being an awful beast

indicators.note: the Greek letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: minor means lesser
tau is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek in a lowly post becomes a terrible creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' suggests a person from Greece but means a letter of its alphabet; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Minotaur was the monster of Greek myth, half man and half bull, kept in the labyrinth.

clue.text: Assuming a bovine look is a bloomer !

definitions.meaning: the eye of an ox, a cow-like gaze

explanation.surface: Looking cowlike is a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder, but it is a flower: the ox-eye daisy.
explanation.definitionFit: Ox-eye is a daisy-like flower, and literally describes a bovine eye.

clue.text: Distributing aid in an Asian country

indicators.note: the letters are spread around in a new order

explanation.surface: Handing out aid in an Asian nation.
explanation.definitionFit: India is a large nation of southern Asia.

clue.text: Gave a hand all round

parts.note: seemingly applauded or helped everyone, but a hand is a set of playing cards given out around the table

explanation.surface: Someone helped or clapped everyone present.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games the cards are distributed to each player.

clue.text: The man will show cold anger if sent up

indicators.note: in a down clue sending up reads the pieces from bottom to top

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
ire is wrath

explanation.surface: A man will be furious if mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: A male first name stands for a particular man.

clue.text: Sound fish from which to breed

indicators.note: the word is said aloud, matching another of the same pronunciation

parts.note: rays are flat fish

explanation.surface: Healthy fish suitable for breeding stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' signals a word heard: RAYS sounds like the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise animals is to rear or breed them.

clue.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

definitions.text: An old missile that's making a comeback

parts.words: An old missile that's making a comeback
parts.note: seemingly a weapon back in fashion, but literally a thrown stick that returns to the thrower

explanation.surface: An antique weapon is becoming popular again.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aboriginal throwing stick is designed to return when thrown.

clue.text: A fabulous heroine who could be called in without hesitation

indicators.note: outside, so the rearranged letters surround the hesitation
the letters could be put in a different order

parts.note: er is a hesitant sound

explanation.surface: A fairy-tale princess who might be summoned without delay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' rearranges CALLED IN into CINDELLA, and 'without' (meaning outside) puts it round ER.
explanation.definitionFit: The rags-to-riches girl of the fairy tale is the heroine of a fable.

clue.text: There's endless book-work for a boss

indicators.note: the final letter is cut off

parts.note: study is work with books

explanation.surface: Endless reading is the lot of a manager.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a projecting knob, the same thing as an ornamental boss.
